{{Quote|I am a kajidic ''lorda''. I have a ''duty'' to my people to show that nobody gets away with an outrage like this. If we let such outrages go unpunished, what would happen to our ''civilization''?|translated=1|[[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] in [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novel)">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' novelization]]</ref>}}
'''Kajidii''', or '''lorda''', was a title referring to the leader of a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]]. Two notable Kajidii were [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] of [[Desilijic/Legends|Desilijic]] kajidic and [[Durga Besadii Tai]] of [[Besadii/Legends|Besadii]].<ref name="The Official Star Wars Fact File 124">{{FactFile|124|HUT 3-4|Durga the Hutt}}</ref><ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novel)" />

Hutts who were the Kajidiis of clans that could trace back their legacy to [[Varl/Legends|Varl]] would represent their clan on the [[Grand Hutt Council/Legends|Hutt Grand Council]] and the Five Hutt Families, the Desilijic clan was one of these.<ref name="TF">''[[Tempest Feud]]''</ref>
